mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 200), the Federal Reserve typically implements restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level above 11000 billion dollars (2017 chained) reflects a strong economic expansion, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 11000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
